maddeler.e:
تعتصمن (form VIII)
# تَعْتَصِمْنَ (taʕtaṣimna) /taʕ.ta.sˤim.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
# تُعْتَصَمْنَ (tuʕtaṣamna) /tuʕ.ta.sˤam.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
